name: Kiora, Master of the Depths
oracle_text:
+1: Untap up to one target creature and up to one target land.
−2: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a creature card and/or a land card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
−8: You get an emblem with "Whenever a creature you control enters, you may have it fight target creature." Then create three 8/8 blue Octopus creature tokens.
blocked_sentences: −8: You get an emblem with "Whenever a creature you control enters, you may have it fight target creature." Then create three 8/8 blue Octopus creature tokens.
−2: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a creature card and/or a land card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.

needs.what: a token definition for an 8/8 blue Octopus creature token (no abilities), e.g. id octopus_8_8_u
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids is a closed list; the only 8/8 blue token is kraken_8_8_u, which has creature type Kraken, not Octopus, so substituting it would be a different token

needs.what: look_at_top picking up to one card of each of several distinct type filters (one creature card and one land card) into hand, rest to graveyard
needs.why_existing_wont_do: look_at_top's objects is a single selector with a count: count 2 over Creature-or-Land would allow two creatures or two lands; destinations entries carry a count and zone but no per-destination type filter, and no shipped card uses a per-type 'and/or' pick
